metadata.title: Student Performance Prediction
metadata.description: Early prediction of Mathematics final grade from background and study characteristics.
metadata.sourceNote: Requested Kaggle archive supplies Portuguese data only; authentic Mathematics file comes from UCI (395 rows).
metadata.targetNote: G1/G2 are historical grades and excluded from the official early-30 scenario.

uncertainty.label: Approximate pointwise post-selection OLS intervals
uncertainty.limitations: Classical individual PI assumes iid homoscedastic normal errors. Robust mean CI is asymptotic; neither accounts for selection uncertainty or guarantees future coverage.

assumptions.interpretation: Bin-mean residual span is 0.586 residual SD; inspect the plotted trend.
assumptions.limitations: A span >0.5 SD is a declared visual screening heuristic, not a significance test. A small span does not establish linearity.
Students have no justified temporal sampling order. DW cannot establish independence; school/group dependence remains possible.

assumptions.interpretation: LM=42.5166, p=0.322; constant variance not rejected.
assumptions.limitations: Rank-reduced auxiliary design includes an intercept. Nonrejection is not proof; temporal dependence and selection can invalidate nominal p-values.

assumptions.interpretation: p=1.56e-06, skew=-0.686, kurtosis=3.580; normality rejected.
assumptions.limitations: Shapiro p-values are not used beyond 5000 observations. Large-sample tests detect small departures; fitted/selected and serially dependent residuals are not iid raw samples. Inspect histogram and Q-Q.

assumptions.method: Design rank, condition number and VIF (intercept excluded)
assumptions.interpretation: Design rank 40/57; 43 perfectly collinear columns; 0 finite VIF values above 10.
assumptions.limitations: VIF >10 is a screening convention, not a universal cutoff. Full one-hot sets create exact aliasing; null VIF plus status denotes infinity/undefined, not zero. Individual aliased coefficients are not unique.
